messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: p99 latency spike observed on continuous-batching path (service=runtime-gen, region=us-west-2). p99 = 3.8s (baseline 0.7s). Paging oncall. Tags: contbatch, streaming, tail-latency
Alex H: saw it, grabbing triage. streaming stalls reported by a customer, some sessions timed out. putting quick notes here.
Maya R: metrics: packer queue depth spiked ~15m ago, median batch size jumped from 8->62 on one pool. KV cache evictions up 4x.
Devon S: interesting — mixed sequence length % of long requests spiked (>=2k tokens). packer combined many small + one huge -> big latency for others.
Kevin L: can someone check scheduler fairness logs? suspect preemption/backfill isn't prioritizing streaming.
Alex H: yep. checking scheduler. `curl -s http://metrics.internal/scheduler/fairness?pool=pb-12` shows streaming_weight dropped to 0.1 (should be 1.0). config drift?
Maya R: i see deploy of `runtime:hotfix/pack-defaults` ~18m ago. maybe changed default `streaming_min_share`.
Devon S: customer-impact: 3 customers reported >5% request errors (timeouts) in last 20m, highest for long-chat streaming. raising severity to Sev3.
ops-bot: PagerDuty alert created -> PD-INC-78432 (oncall: SRE Shift). escalation window 15m.
SRE Shift: taking over paging/coord. Alex, can you capture immediate mitigations?
Alex H: immediate mitigations attempted: 1) reduced `max_batch_size` from 128 -> 48 on affected pools via runtime flag; 2) forced `streaming_priority=high` on streaming route; 3) enabled KV-prefetch (experiment) — results: p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.9s, p99 still ~2.1s. partial improvement.
Maya R: logs show many `pack_timeout` events when a large request blocks pack assembly. we could also ensure long requests go to dedicated lanes (fastpath) or cap long-request packability.
Devon S: suggested config change: set `max_batch_token_budget=40000` and `prefer_streaming_slots=true` for contbatch packs. quick command: 
```
redwoodctl runtime update-pool pb-12 --set max_batch_size=48 --set prefer_streaming_slots=true
```
Kevin L: do we have quick rollback of the hotfix deploy? If the hotfix changed streaming weight, rolling back may help.
Alex H: rollback queued but it's a multi-service change. prefer safer config change first.
SRE Shift: action items: Alex -> continue monitoring p99 after current tweaks. Maya -> confirm KV eviction baseline and consider temporary TTL bump. Devon -> prepare canary for long-request isolation (route to `long-requests` pool). Kevin -> own rollback plan if configs fail. I'll coordinate customer comms.
Maya R: bumping cache TTL for embeddings/kv by +30s on pb-12: `rwcctl cache update --pool pb-12 --ttl-add 30`
Devon S: canary script (one-liner): `for i in {1..50}; do curl -H "X-Trace: contbatch-canary" http://svc.internal/long?size=2500 & done` -> running now against `long-requests` pool.
Alex H: metrics update (5m after changes): p95=0.86s, p99=1.95s, packer-queue-depth down 60%. good trend but not back to baseline.
SRE Shift: good. prepare customer update: short blurb ready?
Kevin L: draft: "We detected increased tail latency impacting streaming sessions due to mixed-length batch amplification. Mitigations applied (batch caps, streaming priority, cache TTL bump). We're monitoring; some customer sessions may see intermittent timeouts. We'll follow up with timeline and permanent fix"
Alex H: +1. Send after 2nd checkpoint once p99 <1.4s or after 30m.
Maya R: collecting grafana links & logs: https://grafana.internal/d/contbatch/packers?orgId=1&var-pool=pb-12
SRE Shift: leaving handoff notes for next shift: root suspected: hotfix changed default streaming weight causing packer to greedily include long requests. Long-term: implement isolation for >1500 token requests, improve packer heuristics and add automatic preemption for streaming.
Devon S: created follow-up ticket RW-INC-2026 with action items + owner assignment.
ops-bot: NOTE: incident bot saved snapshot: s3://incidents/1766543210/contbatch-snapshot.tar.gz
Alex H: lowering severity if p99 holds. next update 15m.
SRE Shift: thanks team — handing off to night shift @Kevin L. I'll update PD notes. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: taking it. ping me if p99 >2.5s or errors >3%.
on-existent-bot (system): reminder: run postmortem template after incident resolves -> https://confluence.internal/pm-template
Alex H: one last note: check routing policy for model variants; fallback to smaller-context model reduced token budget and helped in one pool. saved a customer session.
Maya R: copying relevant logs to ticket RW-INC-2026.
SRE Shift: end of thread for now. stay alert. :eyes:
